features: Spectra III Series integrated dome system
18X optical zoom, 10X digital zoom day/night camera
auto focus LowLight color/optics package with mechanical IR-cut filter
freeze frame between presets, one dynamic window blank
tilt +2 to -92 degrees with auto flip
250 deg/sec pan preset speed, 200 deg/sec tilt preset speed
on-screen compass and tilt display, zone blanking

frigate.notes: Analog PTZ dome (CVBS over coax with Coaxitron/D protocol control) — not a direct IP/RTSP source; ingest via an analog encoder/DVR RTSP output.

home_assistant.notes: Analog PTZ dome; view via a compatible encoder/DVR.

blue_iris.notes: Connect via an analog capture/encoder; PTZ over Coaxitron/RS-422.
